common.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this page.
i18n.unreviewed: Translation not yet reviewed by agricultural experts. Important guidance is shown in English with the translation alongside.
offline.banner: You are offline. Showing saved information; new data cannot be fetched.
offline.cached: Showing information saved on {time}. It may be out of date.
offline.queued: {n} report(s) waiting to be sent when you are back online.
footer.disclaimer: CropPulse shows satellite and weather evidence and unvalidated screening indicators. It is not an official drought declaration, crop-loss assessment or diagnosis. Check your field and consult an agricultural expert before acting.
footer.attribution: Data: NASA MODIS (MOD13Q1, MCD12Q1) via ORNL DAAC; NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project. Map © OpenStreetMap contributors.
login.title: Sign in to CropPulse
login.intro: Field-level satellite and weather evidence, with expert review.
about.title: What CropPulse does — and does not do
about.body1: CropPulse compares recent satellite greenness (NASA MODIS, 250 m) and weather (NASA POWER) for your field with the same time of year in earlier years, and tells you how unusual it is, how recent the data are and how confident it can be.
about.body2: It cannot see pests, disease or problems smaller than about 5 hectares, and it cannot tell you the cause of a problem. Experts review cases and record verified findings.
register.title: Create a farmer account
register.name: Your name
register.org_help: If your FPO or extension office gave you a code, enter it so its experts can help you (only with your consent below).
consent.title: Your data choices
consent.intro: CropPulse needs your field location and crop to show you information. Everything below is optional and can be changed later in your profile.
consent.manage_intro: Change your choices at any time (policy version {version}). Turning a choice off stops future sharing.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw any choice later. Withdrawing does not delete data already shared for a case.
consent.share_with_organization: Share my fields with my organisation
consent.share_with_organization_help: Experts and managers in your FPO/extension organisation can see your fields and assessments.
consent.expert_review_help: When the evidence or your report needs it, an expert from your organisation can review your field and contact you.
consent.aggregated_research: Include my fields in anonymous regional statistics
consent.aggregated_research_help: Only counts for groups of at least 3 fields are shown; never your name or location.
consent.notifications_help: Alerts are always shown in the app; this also allows messages outside the app when available.
farmer.no_fields: You have not registered a field yet.
advisory.title: Official advisories
advisory.none: No current official advisories have been entered for your area.
advisory.manual_note: Advisories are copied by an administrator from official sources such as IMD (mausam.imd.gov.in). CropPulse does not make forecasts.
register_field.title: Register a field
register_field.how: How do you want to mark your field?
register_field.mode_draw: Draw the boundary on the map
register_field.mode_point: Use my current location (I am standing in the field)
register_field.location_denied: Location is not available. Allow location access or draw the boundary instead.
register_field.point_note: A single point does not tell us the field's size; the satellite pixel around it may include other land.
register_field.need_boundary: Mark at least 3 corners, choose a location, or paste a valid GeoJSON geometry.
register_field.name: Field name
register_field.sowing_uncertain: I am not sure of the exact sowing date
register_field.calendar_unreviewed: Crop stages are not shown yet: the crop calendar has not been reviewed by an agronomist. CropPulse shows days since sowing instead.
register_field.data_title: What CropPulse will do with this information
register_field.data_boundary: Store your field boundary to look up satellite and weather data for it.
register_field.data_crop: Use your crop, season and sowing date to interpret the data.
register_field.data_sources: Request NASA satellite data for the area around your field and NASA weather data for a ~50 km grid cell (the exact field location is not sent for weather).
register_field.data_not_shared: Your field is not shared with anyone unless you choose so.
register_field.processing_time: The first data download covers about 16 years of satellite history and can take 30 minutes or more. You can leave the page.
geom_warning.field_smaller_than_modis_pi: This field is smaller than one satellite pixel (about 5.4 ha). Satellite values will include surrounding land.
geom_warning.point_only_boundary_unknown: Only a point was given. The field boundary is unknown.
map.draw_hint: Tap the corners of your field on the map, in order.
map.draw_aria: Map for drawing the field boundary
field.ingest_running: Satellite and weather data are being downloaded. This page refreshes automatically.
field.no_assessment_yet: No assessment yet. CropPulse has not received enough data for this field.
field.no_assessment_yet_running: No assessment yet — data are still being downloaded.
field.assessment_expired: This assessment expired on {date}. It may no longer describe the field. Update the data.
field.latency_note: Satellite images are 16-day composites that become available 2–4 weeks after the period ends. Weather data arrive a few days late. Neither is a live view of your field.
field.pixel_note: Each point is the average of 250 m satellite pixels over your field for a 16-day period. A pixel can include roads, trees or neighbouring fields.
field.no_cases: No expert case for this field.
risk.normal_for_reference_period: Usual for this time of year
risk_help.insufficient_evidence: CropPulse cannot say whether the crop is normal or stressed with the data available. This is not the same as 'healthy'.
risk_help.normal_for_reference_period: Satellite greenness and recent weather are within the range seen in earlier years for this period.
risk_help.watch: One indicator is unusual. This is a prompt to look at the field, not a diagnosis.
risk_help.elevated_risk: Greenness has been unusually low for several weeks and the weather has been unusual too. The cause is not known.
risk_help.expert_review_recommended: The evidence and/or your report should be reviewed by an expert.
risk_help.verified_stress: An expert has inspected and confirmed crop stress.
risk_help.resolved: The case has been resolved by an expert.
uncertainty.title: How certain is this?
uncertainty_screening_unvalidated: This is a screening rule that has not yet been validated against verified field outcomes in this region. Treat it as a prompt to check, not a prediction.
uncertainty_validated: This model has been validated for this crop and region; see the model card for its measured performance.
uncertainty.reference_years: Compared with {n} earlier year(s) for the same 16-day period.
uncertainty.z_interval: Depending on which earlier years are used, the anomaly score ranges from {lo} to {hi}.
uncertainty.valid_pixels: {pct}% of satellite pixels over the field were usable (not cloudy).
uncertainty.single_pixel: The field is represented by a single satellite pixel around its centre.
uncertainty.no_probability: CropPulse does not give a probability of crop loss.
check.pixel_is_cropland: Satellite pixel is classified as cropland
check.field_resolved_by_pixels: Field covered by its own pixels
check.independent_indicators: At least two independent data sources
check_detail.zero_variance: earlier years too similar to compare
check_detail.model_not_validated: not validated — experts review elevated cases
expl_vegetation_below_reference: Greenness ({index} {value}) for {period_start}–{period_end} is lower than in most earlier years for the same period (percentile {percentile}, compared with {n} years, {reference_years}). Low for {consecutive} period(s) in a row.
expl_vegetation_within_reference: Greenness for {period_start}–{period_end} is within the usual range for this period (percentile {percentile} among {n} earlier years).
expl_low_greenness_alternatives: Low greenness can also follow harvest, late sowing, a change of crop, flooding or cloud effects. The satellite cannot tell the cause.
expl_latest_composite: The latest usable satellite composite covers {period_start}–{period_end} ({age_days} days ago).
expl_vegetation_unavailable: No usable satellite vegetation data are available for the assessment period.
expl_coarse_resolution: The satellite pixel (about 250 m) is larger than or not aligned with the field; values may include neighbouring land.
expl_land_cover_not_cropland: The satellite land-cover map ({year}) does not classify this location as cropland (class {class}). The vegetation signal may not describe your crop.
expl_sowing_unknown: Sowing date is unknown, so crop stage cannot be considered.
expl_rain_30d_low: Rainfall over the 30 days to {window_end} was {total_mm} mm, lower than in most of the years {reference_years} (percentile {percentile}; usual {reference_mean_mm} mm).
expl_rain_30d_context: Rainfall over the 30 days to {window_end} was {total_mm} mm (percentile {percentile} for {reference_years}; usual {reference_mean_mm} mm).
expl_rain_dry_season: Little rain is normal at this time of year, so rainfall deficits are not assessed.
expl_dry_spell: {days} consecutive days with less than {threshold_mm} mm rain.
expl_heat_days: {days} days with maximum temperature at or above {threshold_c} °C in the last {window_days} days.
expl_soil_moisture_unavailable: Soil-moisture data are not available (source status: {status}).
expl_farmer_report_open: You reported a problem; an expert review is open.
expl_expert_verified: An expert has verified the field condition.
guidance.none: No approved guidance for this situation.
symptom_not_diagnosis: Symptoms such as wilting or yellowing can have many causes — water shortage, waterlogging, pests, disease, nutrients or heat. A satellite image cannot tell them apart.
chart.veg_aria: Chart of satellite greenness for {n} periods compared with earlier years
chart.key_band: Usual range (10th–90th percentile of earlier years)
chart.hover_hint: Hover or tap the chart for values, or open the table.
chart.rain_aria: Bar chart of daily rainfall for {n} days
chart.tooltip_rain_missing: {date}: not yet available from the source
weather.grid_note: Model-based reanalysis for a ~50 km grid cell around your field — not a rain-gauge reading from your field, and not a forecast.
report.title: Report a problem in your field
report.choose_symptom: Choose at least one thing you see.
report.fraction: How much of the field is affected?
report.irrigated_recently: Has the field been irrigated in the last week?
report.photo_privacy: Location data inside photos is removed before storage.
report.sent: Thank you. Your report is saved with your field.
report.sent_expert: Thank you. An expert from your organisation has been asked to review it.
report.queued: You appear to be offline. The report is saved on this device and will be sent automatically when you are online. Photos were not saved; add them later.
alert.intro: Alerts appear only when the evidence rules are met with recent data. Repeated alerts for the same unchanged condition are suppressed.
alert.expert_required: An expert review is required before deciding on any treatment or input.
alert_watch_message: An unusual vegetation or weather pattern was detected. This does not establish its cause. Please check your field.
alert_elevated_message: Greenness has been unusually low for several weeks together with unusual weather. An expert review is recommended before any treatment.
profile.delete_body: Request deletion of your account, fields and reports. Verified findings already used for research are kept only in anonymised form, as described in the privacy notice.
profile.delete_confirm: Request deletion of your account and data?
expert.queue_intro: Cases from farmer requests and escalated assessments in your organisation. Machine-generated evidence is shown separately from expert input.
expert.machine_note: Unvalidated screening output with its inputs, timestamps and method version.
expert.source_ref_label: Source document or URL for this recommendation
expert.recommendation_note: Recommendations are shown to the farmer as expert-authored. Cite official guidance where possible.
expert.verify_note: Only record what you verified. Your identity and the time are stored with the finding, and verified findings become evaluation labels.
expert.verify_confirm: Record this verified finding? It cannot be edited afterwards.
org.title: Organisation overview
org.intro: {n} field(s) whose owners agreed to share with your organisation, ordered by evidence-based priority.
org.export_note: Counts by district, crop and state only; groups under 3 fields are suppressed.
regional.title: Regional monitoring
regional.meta: {n} consenting field(s); groups under {k} hidden; generated {date}
regional.map_title: Coarse grid cells with registered fields
regional.map_note: Cells are ~50 km NASA POWER grid cells; only cells with enough consenting fields are shown. Hover for 30-day rainfall percentile.
research.title: Research & data provenance
research.intro: Sources, their live status, feature definitions, model versions and evaluation runs. No private field data are shown here.
admin.title: Administration
admin.advisory_note: Copy the advisory exactly from the official source and include its URL. Do not enter forecasts that are not from an official source.
synthetic.title: Synthetic test data.
synthetic.body: Values on this page come from labelled test fixtures, not from satellites or weather services. Do not use them for decisions.
